name: Gmina Góra (Poland)
description: Seven wedge-shaped stripes radiating from the hoist and widening towards the fly — white, light blue, yellow, green, yellow, light blue and red — with the gmina arms in the upper hoist.
history: Polish gmina flags are established by resolution of the gmina council under the Act on Badges and Uniforms, normally after an opinion of the Heraldic Commission; the flag takes the colours of the arms.

features.role: seven wedge-shaped stripes radiating from the hoist
